description.describe_ch:
This course introduces programming as a creative tool for designers. Students will learn fundamental programming concepts and apply them to two domains:
Screen-based Interactivity — using JavaScript and p5.js to design interactive visual interfaces.
Physical Interactivity — using Arduino to prototype tangible, sensor-based interactions.
By the end of the course, students will be able to design and prototype interactive experiences that bridge digital and physical worlds.
